verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is indirect: the CLI can create a SvelteKit project from a 'playground URL', which implies an in-browser playground where code can be written without local setup. Nothing in the pack documents a guided interactive tutorial, and the getting-started material shown is a local npm workflow. Missing for 10: evidence of a guided interactive in-browser tutorial, direct first-party docs describing the playground itself, independent or hands-on corroboration of learning in the browser.
